_about: Questions whose answer is written down somewhere in this repo, with the files that hold it. 'accept' lists every file where the answer genuinely lives; a question counts as found when one of them is among the top results. 'split' is dev or test: retrieval was tuned by reading only the dev failures, and the test split is reported separately so an improvement cannot be one that merely memorised the questions it was tuned on. 'negative' questions have no answer in the repo and must return nothing. Written before the retrieval changes of 2026-10-02, by someone who knew the corpus - which favours the questions that are easy to phrase - so the absolute numbers are optimistic; the before/after difference is the finding.
